map.TSV 用 \t 分隔，字段内逗号无需转义。: TSV separates with a 	, so commas inside fields need no escaping.
map.字段里有制表符怎么办？: What if a field contains a tab character?
map.TSV 的弱点正在于此：分隔符是制表符，而它不像 CSV 有普遍遵循的引号转义约: This is exactly TSV's weakness: its delimiter is a tab, yet unlike CSV it has no widely followed quoting convention, so parsers behave inconsistently. The safe approach is to replace tabs and newlines in values with spaces before converting, or simply switch to CSV, whose escaping rules are defined by RFC 4180.
